observations.why: Present-continuous 'we're switching' performs a settled course change the speaker expects others to act on — decision-grade, not a claim being argued.
Flat unhedged assertions offered as justification for the switch — asserted and defensible, but no ratification or operational language; claim.
Arrow notation records a settled migration as a performed declarative under the principal's name — decision-grade ratification, not a proposal.
Reported performance figure stated as flat assertion without ratification or commitment language — claim-level, defensible but moveable.
A fixed timeline stated as a settled commitment the speaker expects others to meet — decision-grade operational anchor, not a notion or a claim being argued.
